behavior: AC1: an event type the registry does not map is refused, and a payload naming another app changes nothing
AC2: a contract that fails the schema is refused with ERROR / WHY / FIX naming the field
AC3: derived values, the committed contract snapshot and the registry cannot drift apart, offline and without SOPS
verification: env -u SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE poetry run pytest tests/test_product_contract_drift.py --no-cov -q

behavior: AC4: the old web receiver is deleted and nothing live references it (the live dispatch is settled by the command in verification.md)
AC5: PLATFORM_APPS is derived from the registry and a registered third product promotes
verification: test -z "$(git grep -n 'PLATFORM_APPS' -- toolkit | grep -v '^toolkit/config/constants.py.*#')" && poetry run pytest tests/test_promotion.py tests/test_product_registry.py tests/test_k8s_generator_secrets.py --no-cov -q

behavior: AC6: a contract cannot widen the registry (image other than the derived one, secret name, hostname collision, oidc at render)
AC7: a non-sha tag or an unresolvable, ambiguous or off-branch commit is refused before any file is written
